text: 【美国企业对特定光谱流式细胞仪系统及其组件提起337调查申请】商务部公告，2026年10月8日，美国Cytek Biosciences, Inc.根据《美国1930年关税法》第337节规定向美国国际贸易委员会提出申请，指控对美出口、在美进口及销售的特定光谱流式细胞仪系统及其组件侵犯其专利权，请求发起337调查，并发布有限排除令和禁止令。美国、中国两家企业涉案。
text_en: [U.S. company files Section 337 complaint over certain spectral flow cytometry systems and components] The Ministry of Commerce announced that on October 8, 2026, Cytek Biosciences, Inc. of the United States filed an application with the U.S. International Trade Commission under Section 337 of the U.S. Tariff Act of 1930, alleging that certain spectral flow cytometry systems and components exported to, imported into, and sold in the United States infringe its patent rights, and requesting the initiation of a Section 337 investigation and the issuance of a limited exclusion order and a cease and desist order. Two companies from the United States and China are involved.
